review.notes: Full review. Sources: DLMF 18.1(i) and all cited equations 18.2.1-18.2.46 read at Release 1.2.8 (all 15 sampled targets; misprint 18.2.11_1 confirmed; 18.2.42-43 cited for a different statement); Szego, Chihara, Rota-Kahaner-Odlyzko not readable legally. Adversarial pass on every statement with recomputed values (exact moments for the weight e^x on [0,1], Legendre, Gaussian, Freud, Bernoulli): no false statement found; one Check index wrong, one unused-hypothesis pair, one README/Lean generality mismatch. Ownership: RandomMatrices 8.2 on main owns the weight case of the recurrence and Christoffel-Darboux (P2). Library declarations opened at the pins; the Tau Ceti inputs are at the pin although the docstring says otherwise. Gate FAIL (tex=1, README line 587); depcheck 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 64 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probe closes 4 of 14 probed theorems (padding).
